facts.fact: MISA Regional says Zambia repealed the offence of criminal defamation of the president, though defamation stays criminal under other Penal Code provisions; the statement gives no date for the repeal, so the document's published date is used.

note: ZNBC journalist McPherson Mukuka's two-week detention under the Cyber Crimes Act was for allegedly recording a private conversation, not for what was said or published, so no fact; MISA Regional is a regional body, and the claimed state-media bias and election-day attacks are not criticism or punishment facts.
